limitations.detail: Chrome CDP touchCancel produces cancelable=false. Creator 3.8.8 pal/input/web/touch-input.js unconditionally calls preventDefault for canvas touch events, producing a browser console error. This verifier keeps all error collection unchanged and applies no engine patch. Native multitouch cancellation is tested via the real pause lifecycle; the separate DOM touchcancel branch is synthetic and explicitly cancelable, not trusted hardware input.
